product_metadata.title: Westinghouse Heated Blanket, Electric Throw with 6 Heating Levels, 4 Hour Auto Off, Overheat Protection, Machine Washable, Flannel (Throw, 50x60 Inches, Charcoal)
features: 【ETL & FCC CERTIFIED】 60HZ, 100 W, Save Energy. Overheat protection design ensure safety during Normative Use. Please read the instructions carefully before use, extend the life of the blanket. Avoid crumpling it up or body press on the resistance wire during use
【 CONTROLLER FEATURES】 4 Hours Auto-Off, 6 Heating Levels for Individual Needs. Memory heating design and even heat distribution for better enjoyment
【 COLD WASH & EASY CARE】 Unplug the controller before laundry, cold machine wash or hand wash. Line dry or tumble dry on low heat, easy and convenient. DO NOT use if wet
【PREMIUM MATERIAL】 Double layers 220 GSM Flannel, both layers bring a better sense of soft. Warming Throw Blanket 50*60 inch, easy for storage or carry with

【APPLICATION & SCENES】 Suitable for single use, watching television, reading books, relaxing at home on couch or sofa; during work on office; outdoors for camping, fishing, bring you a warm and comfortable life experience
【EXCELLENT SATISFACTION】 5-year warranty for quality issue, we're always here to help you. Westinghouse is dedicated to making lives easier and more enjoyable
